# John Suarez

> Personal site of John Suarez: projects, art, and a standing interest in math. Programmer who likes learning new things and connecting with people about their passions.

Also reachable at johnsuarez.com.

## New projects

- [Phone in the Middle](https://phoneinthemiddle.com): Floor games for families. Set the phone down in the middle, sit in a circle, and play with each other.
- Sandswept: Hyperlocal weather for iOS, straight from your own Tempest station, with Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets.
- Job Monitor: Automated scraper that watches company career pages and pings Slack on relevant openings.
- Moonrise Monitor: Slack bot for moon-phase tracking and viewing conditions, with weather data.

## Old projects

- [Nomad Custodian](https://github.com/jsuar/nomad-custodian): CLI for Nomad administrators to manage job resources with cost and maintenance in mind.
- [go-cron-descriptor](https://github.com/jsuar/go-cron-descriptor): Go library that turns cron expressions into human-readable strings.
- Home Assistant, Slack integration: Maintainer contributions to the Slack integration.
